annotations.title: Hang up or transfer a live call

description: Act on a call that is live right now on one of the brand's own Twilio or Telnyx numbers. action hangup (ends it for everyone on it) | transfer (a blind transfer: to is a phone number or sip: address, callerId one of the brand's numbers, default the number the call is on; the leg Hermoso was running drops). callId from list_calls. Both change nothing without confirm:true; show the user the dry run first. The provider bills a transfer's new leg; free in Hermoso. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

callerId.description: transfer: one of the brand's numbers
